title: Nonlinear total variation based noise removal algorithms
authors: Leonid I. Rudin, Stanley Osher, Emad Fatemi
annotation: The seminal paper proposing the Rudin-Osher-Fatemi (ROF) variational model for edge-preserving image denoising using Total Variation regularizers.

title: Distributed Optimization and Statistical Learning via the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers
authors: Stephen Boyd, Neal Parikh, Eric Chu, Borja Peleato, Jonathan Eckstein
publisher: Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning
annotation: Comprehensive treatise on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM), variable splitting, proximal operators, and primal/dual convergence rates.

title: Rank-Deficient and Discrete Ill-Posed Problems: Numerical Aspects of Linear Inversion
publisher: SIAM (Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics)
annotation: Authoritative textbook on the discrete Picard condition, truncated SVD, L-curve regularization parameter choice, and Tikhonov regularized least squares.

title: An introduction to continuous optimization for imaging
annotation: Rigorous mathematical survey on convex optimization algorithms in modern image science, primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) methods, and non-smooth variational problems.
